Replace the `BD-V-085` marker at EG line 204. | EG: 202 | Distinguishes the learner reassessment loop from assessor calibration and cohort moderation. | **Reassessment and educator quality review.** Show three labelled lanes. Learner: Not yet → private criterion-specific feedback → focused practice → same or approved equivalent task → new evidence → update Grid only when sufficient; incomplete evidence loops back. Assessor before delivery: score annotated MS/NY examples for T2, P9, selected P11 → compare judgments → resolve differences → retain calibration record. Cohort: lead or approved second reviewer checks each variant setup and samples records including disputed, reassessed, and safety-critical cases → corrections through approved record process. No automatic promotion from Not yet, public rankings, lowered standards, or replacement of direct observation. Caption: `Improve evidence and consistency without lowering the standard.` Alt text: `Learners receive private feedback, practise, and provide new evidence after Not yet. Educators calibrate judgments before delivery and moderate cohort records through the approved process; review never substitutes for observed performance.` Master: `y_assets (archived)/diploma/bd-v-085.svg`. | Three-lane process diagram; full width. |
